game.q: a new thing, out in the dry wilderness. what does God say he’ll make there?

wrong.outlet: the wilderness needed water, not parking.
wrong.wifi: you’d want it too. but no.

game.right: YES. a road and rivers. in a desert, that means a way home, and life where nothing grows.

end.line: exiles stuck on their glory days heard it: don’t dwell. look. something new is springing up.

cliff.s1: she comes for water at noon.
cliff.s2: in the heat, when no one else is there.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: the woman at the well.

share: their best days were behind them. or so they thought. from Isaiah, on infinite hill
